entries.title: Rag-Coat Stake Scarecrow
entries.description: One newly authored whole static field-scarecrow appearance: a ground stake and crossarm support an asymmetric thick rag-coat body with two drooping sleeves and genuinely jagged hem outline, two unequal hanging trouser legs, two jagged bundled-straw hand silhouettes, an anonymous sack head and a broad-brim peaked straw-hat form. Nine closed editable meshes, five opaque constant matte PBR roles. No old laundry shirt or beekeeping hat geometry is imported or extracted: all numerical body, clothes, straw and hat outlines are newly authored as one farm field fixture. Clothes and hat are closed solid game-art volumes, not hollow wearable tailoring; small fixed overlaps are explicit. Metres, Z up, whole horizontal bounds centre, stake sole at Z0. Inanimate stylised prop only, no identity of a person, rig, wind/cloth simulation, actual pest-deterrence, real installation, stability, weatherproofing or safety claim.

entries.title: Twin-Track Clay Storage Chest
entries.description: One original static empty clay-storage chest from the ceramics storage-box plan. A single thick deep rectangular shell has a complete bottom and unpartitioned open cavity. Two continuous side rails each contain two genuine full-length recessed channels; two separate thick cover panels sit at different fixed heights and overlap toward the rear, leaving a clear front access opening. Each cover has a true rectangular finger aperture. Five closed pieces, three constant opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up, front -Y, grounded centred origin. Newly authored shell, dual-channel cross-sections and pierced covers, not a resized round jar, six-compartment bait box, cushioned seatbox or low-front picking bin. No contents, hinge, animation, tested sliding travel, sealing, moisture retention, material suitability, capacity, load, manufacture or safety certification.

entries.title: Swept-Blade Double-Grip Scythe
entries.description: One newly authored whole static mowing-scythe appearance: a long continuously bent S-like wooden snath rises out of a broad low swept tapered steel blade, with two complete offset cranked side grips at different heights and one genuine annular lower metal collar. Five closed editable meshes and three opaque matte PBR roles. The blade is a new open swept leaf profile with finite blunt thickness, not the previous nearly circular 225-degree sickle band; the snath, blade-plane relationship and offset grip paths are new, not a scaled sickle or the straight shaft/transverse plate of the old hoe. No prior visible geometry imported or extracted. Hidden small fixed overlaps connect the static display. Metres, Z up, actual whole horizontal bounds centre, blade underside at Z0. Blunt stylised game-art appearance only: no mowing/cutting instructions, manufacture, blade sharpness, ergonomic fit, balance, working mechanism, animation, stability or real-tool safety claim.

entries.title: Ten-Channel Pocket Harmonica
entries.description: One complete static pocket harmonica exterior: two complete curved finite-thickness metal covers around one connected wooden comb with ten real front-open air channels, eleven whole dividers/end walls and a continuous rear spine. Three editable closed solids and two opaque solid PBR materials. The mouths are real assembled gaps, not ten black rectangles painted on a solid block. No separate ten-pipe array, keyboard tines or whistle lanyard. Metres, Z up, horizontally centred, lower cover finite flat face at Z0. Small fixed cover-to-spine overlaps are declared mounts. Internal reeds, reed plates and fastener details are intentionally not represented in this lightweight visual model; no tuning, sound, airflow, manufacturing, animation or safety performance claimed.

entries.title: Culvert Road Crossing with Flared Drain Inlet
entries.description: One static village drainage-road crossing scene, one scene and zero new independent models. One whole original stone box culvert road module and two whole original soil road grade modules follow the original three-piece arrangement with 2mm end gaps. One complete newly self-reviewed flared wing headwall meets the front lining mouth at the declared matching opening. All original mesh sets, oriented triangles and per-face opaque PBR values are retained at unit scale, with only exact 180-degree coordinate permutation, translations and collision-safe names. Seven meshes,426triangles,nine materials. Original culvert is one joined runtime mesh of touching closed parts and retains four canonical-weld nonmanifold edge diagnostics; it is not claimed to be a newly repaired single manifold body. No water, terrain insertion, hydraulic capacity, watertight soil installation, road safety, navigation, construction or engineering certification.

entries.title: Three-Well Shallow Ceramic Dish
entries.description: One original static shallow ceramic serving dish from the ceramics shallow-plate plan, not a rescaled single-cavity mixing bowl. One connected closed solid includes a full planar bottom, continuous outer wall and annular rim, central hub and three full-depth radial material dividers. These form three genuine separate 110-degree shallow blind wells with their own integral floors and inner walls; no independent bowls, pasted dark patches, overlapping surfaces or loose divider bars. 0.38 m diameter, 0.035 m height, 0.009 m bottom, three 10-degree solid divider sectors. One editable mesh, one constant opaque celadon PBR, metres and ground-centred origin. Static game exterior only; no food-contact, thermal, liquid, load, manufacture or safety certification.

entries.title: Static Limbless Tadpole
entries.description: One original stylised limbless amphibian-larva-inspired appearance. A broad blunt rounded head-body continues directly into one long gently sideways-bent tapering muscular tail, with a complete finite-thickness upper and lower tail-fin envelope in the very same closed shared-vertex surface. Two small dark eyes are visibly inset into the broad head. Newly authored whole axial sections, belly, taper, curvature and fin silhouette; no adult frog head or body is copied, shrunk or stripped of limbs, and no old octopus arm, fish-skeleton tail or fishing-float profile is reused. One complete body/fin mesh plus two small closed eye meshes, three opaque matte PBR materials. One prop and zero scenes, not multiple growth stages or a whole life cycle. Metres, native Z up, presentation front -Y and head toward -X, complete horizontal bounds-centred grounded belly display. Static artistic exterior only, no real species, life-size or developmental-stage accuracy, internal anatomy, biological transparency, swimming, growth, animation, breathing, buoyancy, welfare or ecological performance claim.

entries.title: Fixed Tail-Vane Farm Windpump
entries.description: One newly authored whole static farm windpump appearance: a four-foot tapered open square braced tower supports a small fixed gearbox, a broad wheel of pitched sheet-like fan vanes on two genuine annular rings and four short inner spokes, a rear projecting tail vane, and a long central connection rod down to a grounded pump-body exterior with one genuinely open finite bent outlet. This is a complete new windpump silhouette and construction, not the old three-blade electric turbine with merely more blades or a copied communications tower. No prior visible mesh is imported or extracted. Closed editable meshes and four opaque constant matte PBR roles. Small embedded junctions fix the display. Metres, Z up, true whole horizontal bounds centre and actual finite ground feet. Static game-art only: no rotation/animation, yaw bearing, gears, crank linkage, fluid path through the housing, wind or water simulation, pumping output, electrical generation, installation, structural stability or engineering/safety certification.

entries.title: Small Ensemble Rehearsal Room
entries.description: One static indoor ensemble rehearsal-room composition; five full unit-scale unchanged published instruments/furniture, no new instrument models. Scene-only floor plus two low cutaway walls. Separate piano/bench, percussion and guitar/score stations face into an open shared central practice area; a wide front entry remains open. No stage, audience row, offstage screen/cart or performance amplification. Not acoustics, ergonomics, accessibility, navigation, electrical, structural or safety certification. Complete original mesh hierarchy, oriented triangles and solid PBR are preserved. One scene preset and zero new independent reusable models.
